children: Origin Bancorp is voluntarily moving its primarily listing to the recently-launched Texas Stock Exchange.
The bank holding company on Tuesday said that its board has decided to delist from the New York Stock Exchange as its primary listing, and will move to the newly launched Dallas-based TXSE.
Origin said it will begin trading on the new exchange effective Oct. 13, under the same stock symbol, OBK.
